title: Which Supply Lines Evidence the Interface Style in Use, PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** When the interface style in use is read from an enrollment's lines in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, the lines that count as evidence are:

1. when the enrollment shows self-pay lines collected at a branch, those lines and any no-charge mask-fit exchange lines count and no other line does — the standing-order lines that the enrollment ships to the recorded style included;
2. when it shows no branch-collected lines but shows no-charge mask-fit exchange lines, only those exchange lines count;
3. otherwise every interface and cushion line counts, shipped lines and no-charge lines of any reason alike.

## Terms

- **Self-pay lines collected at a branch:** lines paid by the patient that were picked up at a Summit Ridge branch. Whether the enrollment shows any is read across all its history.
- **No-charge mask-fit exchange lines:** no-charge replacements sent because a newly shipped interface or cushion did not fit.
- **Standing-order lines:** self-pay lines the enrollment ships on its standing order to the recorded style; under line 1 they do not count.

## Evidence table

| Branch-collected self-pay lines on the enrollment | Mask-fit exchange lines on the enrollment | Lines that count |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | branch-collected self-pay lines and mask-fit exchange lines only |
| no | yes | mask-fit exchange lines only |
| no | no | every interface and cushion line |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- An enrollment has ground-shipped standing-order nasal cushion lines and two nasal pillow pairs collected at a branch: only the branch lines (and any fit-exchange lines) count; the standing-order nasal cushion lines do not.
- An enrollment with no branch collections and one fit-exchange line of pillow pairs: only that exchange line counts.
- An enrollment with neither: every interface and cushion line counts, including coverage-billed and no-charge lines of any reason.
